requirements.text: Missing home links select home installation; an unspecified destination is clarified before fetching or writing, and explicit upstream refreshes recommend the external owner without granting execution authority.
A request to refresh .agents as a whole selects both repository skills and the portable AGENTS.md baseline, and audits the result.
A request for only AGENTS.md or only skills selects just that target without synchronizing repository-local AGENTS.local.md.

cases.prompt: Nel repository vedo tutte le skill Addy, ma nella mia ~/.agents/skills ne mancano due. Allinea le skill installate.
cases.initial_state: Repository bundles exist; their home links are absent. The user requests a skills-only home change.
cases.expected_output: Review the home skills plan, sync only skills when clean and authorized, then audit the links. Do not fetch upstream sources.

assertions.text: Repository presence is not presented as evidence that home links exist.
Only skills are selected and the final link audit is reported.

pass: The transcript shows home-link planning and a skills-only sync followed by audit.
fail: A repository audit substitutes for a home audit, or unrelated targets change.

cases.prompt: Allinea le skill, quelle di Addy non ci sono tutte.
cases.initial_state: The user names no destination and has not authorized a home change or an upstream fetch.
cases.expected_output: Ask which destination is missing resources before selecting a fetching or mutating workflow.

assertions.text: The agent obtains the missing destination decision before network or mutation.

forbidden_actions: Treat an unanswered clarification as authorization.
Run real-home commands without a home request.

pass: The destination remains an explicit decision and no dependent operation runs before the answer.
fail: The agent assumes a destination or grants itself permission through routing.

cases.prompt: Prepara gli import del manifest allo SHA fissato; lascia stare la mia installazione personale.
cases.initial_state: The user requests declared upstream snapshots and explicitly excludes home changes.
cases.expected_output: Recommend the external-sync owner and leave home installation untouched.

assertions.text: The external owner is recommended without running a home sync.

forbidden_actions: Infer home authorization from the handoff.

pass: The route preserves the upstream-only destination and its authorization.
fail: A home plan or apply substitutes for the requested source operation.

cases.prompt: Aggiorna questa skill con il repo attuale, poi lanciala per aggiornare .agents.
cases.initial_state: The repository skill catalog has changed and the home baseline and skill links are stale; the user authorizes a home update.
cases.expected_output: Review the plan, run sync --targets skills,agents.md, audit both targets, and report applied operations and blockers.

assertions.text: The sync selects skills and agents.md together.
A post-sync audit checks both targets and reports drift or blockers.

pass: Both home targets are refreshed and the final audit is reported.
fail: Only skills or only AGENTS.md is refreshed despite the whole-.agents request.

cases.initial_state: The user explicitly limits the update to the global baseline.
cases.expected_output: Use sync --targets agents.md and leave the skill target unselected.

assertions.text: Only agents.md is selected and AGENTS.local.md remains repository-local.

pass: The global baseline is refreshed without expanding scope.
fail: The entire home skill catalog is refreshed or local policy is copied.

queries.query: Le skill sono nel checkout, ma non le trovo in ~/.agents/skills: installale.
Prepara i sorgenti esterni fissati dal manifest senza installarli nella home.
Aggiorna tutte le risorse del repo dentro ~/.agents.
Allinea le skill e il baseline AGENTS.md in .agents al repository.
Aggiorna le risorse AI del repository in un altro progetto consumer.
Aggiorna le risorse AI scaricandole dai cataloghi esterni.
